response.sql: WITH zone_type_averages AS (SELECT sc.zoneref, s.typesite, AVG(sc.pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_minute FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_compression_ratio) AS average_compression_ratio, AVG(avg_size_per_minute) AS average_size_per_minute FROM zone_type_averages;

assumptions.assumption: Scans with zero duration have no defined size-per-minute value, so they are excluded from that average.
